kurals.tr: Thotangarka Evvinaiyum Ellarka Mutrum / Itanganta Pinal Ladhu
kurals.m: Let not (a king) despise (an enemy), nor undertake any thing (against him), until he has obtained (a suitable) place for besieging him

kurals.tr: Muranserndha Moimpi Navarkkum Aranserndhaam / Aakkam Palavun Tharum
kurals.m: Even to those who are men of power and expedients, an attack in connection with a fortification will yield many advantages

kurals.tr: Aatraarum Aatri Atupa Itanarindhu / Potraarkan Potrich Cheyin
kurals.m: Even the powerless will become powerful and conquer, if they select a proper field (of action), and guard themselves, while they make war on their enemies

kurals.tr: Enniyaar Ennam Izhappar Itanarindhu / Thunniyaar Thunnich Cheyin
kurals.m: If they who draw near (to fight) choose a suitable place to approach (their enemy), the latter, will have to relinquish the thought which they once entertained, of conquering them

kurals.tr: Netumpunalul Vellum Mudhalai Atumpunalin / Neengin Adhanaip Pira
kurals.m: In deep water, a crocodile will conquer (all other animals); but if it leave the water, other animals will conquer it

kurals.tr: Katalotaa Kaalval Netundher Katalotum / Naavaayum Otaa Nilaththu
kurals.m: Wide chariots, with mighty wheels, will not run on the ocean; neither will ships that the traverse ocean, move on the earth

kurals.tr: Anjaamai Allaal Thunaiventaa Enjaamai / Enni Itaththaal Seyin
kurals.m: You will need no other aid than fearlessness, if you thoroughly reflect (on what you are to do), and select (a suitable) place for your operations

kurals.tr: Sirupataiyaan Sellitam Serin Urupataiyaan / Ookkam Azhindhu Vitum
kurals.m: The power of one who has a large army will perish, if he goes into ground where only a small army can act

kurals.tr: Sirainalanum Seerum Ilareninum Maandhar / Urainilaththotu Ottal Aridhu
kurals.m: It is a hazardous thing to attack men in their own country, although they may neither have power nor a good fortress

kurals.tr: Kaalaazh Kalaril Nariyatum Kannanjaa / Velaal Mukaththa Kaliru
kurals.m: A fox can kill a fearless, warrior-faced elephant, if it go into mud in which its legs sink down
